next.reason: 1985 Permanent Error definition (unsuccessful from an error precluding further processing; exception procedures executed; condition persists unless an implementor-defined technique corrects it). §2023:9.1.13.1 repeats it verbatim ('The permanent error condition remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file'; prose, no catalog row, PB479). Catalog carriers of parts: §2023:9.1.13.6 GR1 ('A permanent error exists'), §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 (procedures executed upon unsuccessful I-O). Same.
